"Sophistisimple"
Mar 2018 • Couples
I made that word up to fit this place during a very pleasant evening in one of HCMC's newest hidden gems. 

The First Restaurant and Bar has an edge of sophistication and and edge of "street" simplicity fused into one characterful establishment that, well, just works. Nestled down a small alley, a stones throw from the bustling CMT8 and New World Hotel, this place has quickly found appeal among discerning yet casual locals and foreigners alike. 

With a combination of good food, good decor, good atmosphere and good service, this locally run restaurant gets the balance between a grown up restaurant and a casual eatery just right. 

We tried the pasta on this occasion, next time I will try the steak and see how it compares to the more up-market (and expensive) steak specialists in town. Watch this space for an update about that.

The First has been firmly added to my roster of places that I will visit regularly and that I take visitors to.
